subject: Re: Kickoff: pre-training vs specialized architectures study
body:
Lucia,

Staffing plan:

- Gustavo 50% throughout — experiment design, owns the recommendation doc.
- Linnea 40% May–June — T5 fine-tuning lanes.
- Halima 40% May–June — specialized-architecture lanes (CGPS reproduction first, it's the fiddliest).
- Farah Haddad is committed at 60% here for all of July 2026 to carry the final sweep infrastructure. She ramps at 20% in June for handover, then owns the big sweep and results pipeline in July. I've confirmed her calendar is clear for it.

Compute: ~40 concurrent V100-class runs at peak. Titan best-effort covers it; no reservation. Single-GPU jobs, embarrassingly parallel.

Risk to flag now: the reference stack is old (TF 1.15 era images). Halima will containerize week one so we don't fight dependencies in June.

Alina
